summary:
Iteration 10 — tested Top Rated badges + Invite vendor to project. Backend: 6 new pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration10.py — all pass (6/6).

Backend verified: GET /api/portfolios returns top_rated, completed_total, offline_projects on every item. ?top_rated=true returns exactly the two seeded top-rated vendors (user_showcase_workshop = Kayu Rupa Workshop and user_demo_supplier = PT Material Nusantara). GET /api/vendors/{id}.top_rated correct. POST /api/admin/reviews: admin success (200), non-admin 403, unknown vendor 404, short comment 422. Adding a 5★ admin review to user_showcase_interior flips top_rated=false→true (completed_total/offline_projects both increment by 1); DELETE /api/admin/reviews/{id} reverts; delete unknown 404; GET /api/admin/reviews lists the new review. POST /api/custom/projects/{pid}/invite: non-owner 403, non-OPEN state 400 (verified after cancel), self-invite 400, unknown/unverified vendor 404, duplicate 400, success 200 adds vendor to invited_vendor_ids + timeline event '…mengundang…' + supplier notification 'Undangan menawar proyek'. GET /api/custom/opportunities as invited supplier: project has invited=true and is first in list; designer sees same project with invited=false. GET /api/custom/projects/{pid}.bids[i] include vendor_top_rated (plus vendor_rating/vendor_review_count).

Frontend (Playwright): Homepage portfolio grid shows TOP RATED badges on 2 cards (portfolio-top-rated-user_showcase_workshop + portfolio-top-rated-user_demo_supplier); checkbox portfolio-filter-top-rated narrows grid from 4→2 cards and all remaining have badges. /vendor/user_showcase_workshop shows vendor-top-rated badge in header; logged-out visitor has NO vendor-cta-invite (expected). As kontraktor buyer: vendor-cta-invite visible → opens invite-dialog with 12 own open projects → invite-button-{pid} click → row flips to invite-done-{pid}. As the invited supplier on /dashboard → Project Board tab: invited-badge-{pid} rendered on that project card and project is sorted first in Opportunities list (confirmed via DOM order). Admin /admin → admin-tab-reviews → admin-review-board visible → fill admin-review-vendor-select=user_showcase_interior, admin-review-reviewer-input, admin-review-subject-input, click review-star-5, admin-review-comment-input, admin-review-submit → new admin-review-{rid} appears in admin-review-list → admin-review-delete-{rid} + confirm dialog removes it. Bid card: created a project where user_demo_supplier (top rated) bids; buyer view shows bid-top-rated-{bid_id} on BidCard.
critical_code_review_comments: reviews.py badges() calls done_count(uid) inside a loop — N+1 queries. OK for current scale (<=50 vendors per page), but switching to a single aggregation over custom_projects/orders/reviews grouped by vendor_id would scale better.
custom_projects.py get_project loads reviews.badges([bid.vendor_id ...]) which itself runs 3 count_documents per vendor — same N+1. Fine for typical bid counts.

custom_projects.py invite_vendor returns {ok, invited_vendor_ids: [*p.get('invited_vendor_ids', []), body.vendor_id]} — reconstructed client-side; could race if duplicate concurrent invites. $addToSet guarantees DB uniqueness so no corruption; just the returned list could duplicate briefly. Minor.
InviteDialog loads client's own projects via /api/custom/projects/mine then filters status=='open'; invited_vendor_ids per-project is reloaded on each invite via refresh — correct.
AdminReviewBoard delete uses native window.confirm — fine, but inconsistent with the rest of the app (shadcn Dialog used elsewhere). Minor polish.

VendorProfile: isOwner uses localStorage user_id check but AuthContext stores user in state via /auth/me. If localStorage key is not kept in sync, logic may misbehave. Verified in practice invite CTA hidden for own profile (showed vendor-not-found for user_demo_buyer who has no business profile).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (portfolio filter, vendor badge, invite dialog + invite flow, invited badge + sort, admin review create/delete, bid-top-rated)

test_credentials: POST /api/auth/demo roles: contractor_buyer | supplier_vendor | designer_creator | admin
seed_data_creation: Created and cancelled 3 TEST custom projects (invited flow + bid-top-rated). All left in 'cancelled' status (not deleted). Did NOT modify demo vendor business_profiles. Admin review added to user_showcase_interior was cleaned up (deleted) at the end of the test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://matshop-3.preview.emergentagent.com MONGO_URL=mongodb://localhost:27017 DB_NAME=test_database python -m pytest backend/tests/test_iteration10.py -n 0 --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/iter10.xml`. New endpoints: POST/GET/DELETE /api/admin/reviews; POST /api/custom/projects/{id}/invite {vendor_id}. New fields: GET /api/portfolios (top_rated, completed_total, offline_projects + ?top_rated=true filter), GET /api/vendors/{id}.top_rated, custom_projects.invited_vendor_ids[], GET /api/custom/opportunities[i].invited, GET /api/custom/projects/{id}.bids[i].vendor_top_rated. Frontend testids: portfolio-top-rated-{user_id}, portfolio-filter-top-rated, vendor-top-rated, vendor-cta-invite, invite-dialog, invite-list, invite-empty, invite-row-{pid}, invite-button-{pid}, invite-done-{pid}, invited-badge-{pid}, admin-tab-reviews, admin-review-board, admin-review-form, admin-review-vendor-select, admin-review-reviewer-input, admin-review-subject-input, review-star-N, admin-review-comment-input, admin-review-submit, admin-review-{rid}, admin-review-delete-{rid}, admin-review-list, bid-top-rated-{bid_id}. Seeded top-rated vendors: user_showcase_workshop + user_demo_supplier. user_showcase_interior sits at avg 4.5 / 2 reviews / 2 done so one admin review tips it to top_rated.
rca of the issue: N/A — all iteration-10 features work end-to-end.
